title: The Keith house's loggia gains its wall piers; every picture now matches
items: A flat stone pier now stands on the wall behind each rear pair of columns in the north loggia at 1808 Prairie. The 1888 floor plan draws it, and the 1888 photograph catches the north one's sunlit side.
The photograph's pale upright beside the rear columns is the pier's face. It is not the door's edge or a third column, and the model now draws it within two pixels of the print.
All sixteen photographs and drawings of the house were compared again, and each one now matches the model.
